g.data:
{"name":"Rules: deviation = round4(abs(value-target)/tolerance); >=1 creates an action, >=2 also a CRITICAL incident.
Metric uniqueness: (source, sourceEventId); correction deduplicationKey is unique.
One ritual in progress per plan; finish rechecks readiness, participants and required events.
Audit entries are append-only. Notify by deduplicated transactional outbox; delivery is a future adapter.","modelType":"NOTE"}

{"name":"Integration limit: services are core-only; UC-4 REST/UI, readiness/rule adapters, execution persistence,
metric sensors, periodic scheduler and durable outbox delivery are not wired.
escalateOverdue() is callable, not a running scheduler.
Local command transaction covers repositories + audit + outbox, not rollback of external Pollen Tree spending.","modelType":"NOTE"}

{"name":"Relations: solid arrow = navigable association / injected dependency; *-- = composition of session snapshots.
Dashed arrow = use/create dependency; hollow dashed triangle = interface realization.
UUID-based associations use IDs, NOT direct object-reference fields or cascade-delete ownership.
PollenService is the only application class accessing PollenTreeClient; no direct database pollen writes.","modelType":"NOTE"}

{"name":"Completeness: all declared fields, constructors and explicit methods of UC-4 types.
Grey <<UC4 projection>> = shared class/interface: only UC-4 operations/literals; other use cases intentionally excluded.
Record fields are private final. Canonical constructors are shown; accessors, equals/hashCode/toString are implicit.
Java-generated enum values/valueOf and compiler-generated helpers are implicit. JDK/Spring internals are not expanded.","modelType":"NOTE"}

{"name":"UC-4 only: RITUAL_READY -> ACTIVE after a successful ritual.
CORRECTION / EMERGENCY are operating conditions, NOT SeasonPlanStatus values.
Critical condition = any operational CRITICAL MagicIncident.
No planning, approval, preparation commands, completion or report subsystem.","modelType":"NOTE"}
{"name":"UC-4 — 3. Implementation view — Поля, методы и связи","modelType":"NOTE"}
